pre_update_notes: Update straight from 2.0.0. 2.0.1 was published but its update got stuck at the first ("backup") step on large catalogs, and everything it contained ships here. That stall is fixed in this release: the pre-update backup now runs a few chunks per request instead of one request that could outlast your host's time limit — but the fix lives in the NEW code, so an install still running 2.0.0 must be updated by hand once (see the manual update steps in the release notes); later updates should be able to use the in-app updater again. The update applies 2 small, additive database migrations (an admin permission and the tables behind the new device alerts), none of which touch your product, order or customer tables. If this is a git-managed install, take a database backup first and pick a quiet hour; the site is in maintenance mode briefly while it runs.
post_update_notes: After the update finishes: (1) open System → Alert control and System → My alerts — admin device alerts (browser/phone push notifications with sound, plus an installable admin app) are new; each admin turns them on per device from the phone icon in the top bar. They need HTTPS, a running queue worker and the Laravel scheduler (cron every minute); on iPhone the admin must first use Add to Home Screen. Installing the PHP bcmath or gmp extension makes sending them faster (optional). (2) Make sure the host cron runs `php artisan schedule:run` every minute — the update watchdog and the alert digests depend on it. (3) The new System → Cleanup page is safe to open any time; its database section only reports, never deletes. (4) Bookmark your OE Recovery console URL (yoursite.com/oe-recovery.php) before you ever need it.
